title: Disney Mickey Mouse Blue Graduation Tumbler - No Lid No Straw
descriptionText:
Celebrate your graduation with this Disney Mickey Mouse Blue Graduation Tumbler. The tumbler features a glittery design with Minnie Mouse and is perfect for your special occasion. Made of plastic, this tumbler does not come with a lid or straw, but it is still a great addition to your collection. Personalization is not available for this item.

This tumbler is perfect for any Disney lover and is a great gift for graduates. Show off your love for Mickey Mouse and Minnie Mouse with this colorful and fun tumbler. Whether you are using it for a special occasion or just as a decorative piece, this tumbler is sure to bring a smile to your face.
